insight-1.title: Individuals vs. teams
insight-1.body: Claude and Claude Cowork are built for everyday and delegated work; Claude Code and the Platform API are built for people who ship software.
insight-2.title: Pricing scales with usage
insight-2.body: Subscription products start around $17-20/mo per seat, while the Platform API bills per token so cost tracks directly with how much you build.
insight-3.title: Everything shares one model family
insight-3.body: All four products draw on the same Claude models, so intelligence and safety behavior stay consistent as you move between them.
faq.title: Common questions
faq-1.question: Can I use more than one Claude product at once?
faq-1.answer: Yes. Many teams pair Claude for everyday work with Claude Code for development, all under one Enterprise plan.
faq-2.question: Do these plans include the latest models?
faq-2.answer: All subscription and API plans include access to the current Claude model family, including Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5.
